Definition: Does the government maintain a digital address register?
Comments: No credible evidence found after searching Somalia national address register digital addressing system.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed as No (Value Code 1, unchanged). No evidence of a national government-maintained digital address register: Somalia's 2019-2024 ICT Policy, the 2025-2029 e-Government Strategy, a 2025 World Bank digital-economy diagnostic, and reporting on the 2025-2030 Digital Transformation Strategy consultation make no mention of an address/addressing register among their systems. The only related initiatives are a 2014 Mogadishu house-numbering/postcode pilot that never matured into a systematic register and region-level (not building-level) UPU postal codes; Somaliland's separate 2020 Hargeisa addressing pilot is outside federal Somalia's jurisdiction. A private consultancy (SINTAD) claims municipal property-digitisation work in several Federal Member State towns, but this is a single self-promotional source and does not establish a government-run national address register, so it is not used to upgrade the score per the single-weak-source rule.
